description:
Implement the `Sandbox` trait on macOS using APFS copy-on-write cloning so each check gets a near-instant, space-efficient clone of the working tree. Prefer `libc::clonefile(2)` (`libc` already a dependency) for a direct `clonefile`/`clonefileat` call over `cp -c`. Place clones under a temp root; clean up on drop.

———
